scope: Proposition 9.1 (Short-time maximal estimate) of the manuscript “Endpoint convergence for the planar Schrodinger equation” (preprints/Endpoint-convergence-for-the-planar-Schrodinger-equation-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 080 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 68d6affc8c3cc3bc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 72. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let p > 2 be the exponent in Theorem 8.1. Fix 0 < c0 < C0 < ∞. If N ≥ 1 is dyadic and supp b fN ⊂ {ξ ∈ R2 : c0N ≤ |ξ| ≤ C0N}, then, on every unit ball B ⊂ R2, sup 0<t<1/N |S(t)fN | Lp,∞(B) ≤ CN1/3 ∥fN ∥2. (9.1) The same estimate holds on every translated time interval of length at most 1/N, with either endpoint included.
